haze.precip_note: Open-Meteo: 347mm over 30d (17 Aug to 15 Sep) vs 344mm clim mean (10 yrs; 2015-2024)
haze.campaign_note1: Neutral — pre-season baseline; no signal to act on yet.
haze.campaign_note2: Re-check when ONI crosses +2.0°C or precip anomaly turns negative.
haze.plain_language1: Everything is calm for now — nothing to worry about yet.
haze.plain_language2: Start paying closer attention once the numbers show real warming or a dry stretch; likely by November.

haze.precip_note: Open-Meteo: 278mm over 30d (09 Sep to 08 Oct) vs 329mm clim mean (10 yrs; 2015-2024)
haze.campaign_note1: PREPARE — very strong El Niño (ONI +2.16°C JAS 2026) and drier than normal rain (-15% over 30 days) ahead of the January to April burning season.
haze.campaign_note2: Now: northern stations average 15 ug/m3 PM2.5 and 102 fire detections in upper northern Thailand over 7 days. Check instruments and forecast runs before January; re-check every two weeks.
haze.plain_language1: The warning signs are in place: the coming smoke season is likely to start earlier and be worse than usual.
haze.plain_language2: The air is still clean for now — use the coming weeks to get ready.
